olx.title: OLX
olx.description: Publish products on OLX and take them down when they sell.
olx.loadError: Could not load the OLX plugin's data. Refresh the page.
olx.disabledHint: Set clientId, clientSecret, redirectUri and encryptionKey in medusa-config.ts and restart Medusa, or set demo: true to try it without an account.
olx.demoHint: Sample categories and an OLX kept in memory: nothing is sent to OLX and store stock does not change.
olx.demoReset: Removes every demo advert. Products and stock are not touched.

issue.repeated_punctuation: the same punctuation mark three times in a row
issue.too_many_capitals: more than half of the letters are capitals
issue.contains_email: OLX does not allow an e-mail address here
issue.contains_website: OLX does not allow a website address here
issue.invalid: enter an amount above zero, e.g. 199.00
issue.not_public: OLX can only download photos from a public https address

conflict.exists: This variant already has an advert. Edit it instead.
conflict.in_progress: This advert is being saved right now. Try again in a moment.
conflict.not_on_olx: This advert is not on OLX yet.
conflict.out_of_stock: This item cannot be bought in the store, so it was not offered on OLX.
conflict.taking_down: This advert is sold or being taken down, so it cannot be changed now.

result.published: Sent to OLX. It goes live after moderation.
result.unconfirmed: OLX did not confirm in time. The plugin will check within 5 minutes and will not send it twice.
result.unconfirmedEdit: OLX did not confirm the change. Check the advert on OLX and save again if it did not apply.

form.textRules: OLX does not allow phone numbers, e-mail or website addresses here.
form.categorySearch: Search for a category, e.g. men's jacket
form.imagesHint: Greyed-out photos are not on a public https address, so OLX cannot download them.
form.paidNotice: Adverts in some categories are paid on OLX. If your account has no free pool or packet left, OLX marks the advert "Over the limit" and you buy a packet on OLX. This plugin never buys anything.
form.phoneWarning: This looks like a phone number, which OLX does not allow. If it is a size or a code, leave it: OLX decides.

sold.title: Sold on OLX?
sold.body: "{{title}}" comes down from OLX and its free stock in the store goes to zero, so nobody can buy it again.

deactivate.title: Take the advert down?
deactivate.body: "{{title}}" disappears from OLX. Store stock does not change.

activate.title: Bring the advert back?
activate.body: "{{title}}" returns to OLX. OLX may charge for it, depending on your account.

adverts.empty: No adverts yet. Open a product and publish it, or use "Publish several".

bulk.title: Publish several products
bulk.hint: Up to {{max}} variants with one category. Title, description, price and photos come from each product; the rest from Settings.

connection.title: OLX account
connection.hint: Connect the OLX account adverts are published from.
connection.disconnectBody: The plugin forgets the account's tokens. Adverts stay on OLX, but stop being taken down automatically until you connect again.
connection.failed: Connecting failed. Check clientId, clientSecret and redirectUri, then try again.
connection.invalid_state: That link has expired. Click "Connect OLX" again.

settings.title: Defaults for new adverts
settings.hint: Filled into every new advert. Adverts already on OLX do not change.
settings.safetyHint: OLX requires this in some categories. Leave it empty unless OLX asks for it. Your accountant or lawyer can say what applies to your goods.
settings.placedBefore: Goods placed on the market before 2024

product.connectFirst: Connect an OLX account to publish

app.title: Register an app on developer.olx.pl
app.body: Sign in with the store's OLX account, fill in the company details and add an app. Redirect URI: https://<your-backend>/hooks/olx/oauth/callback. OLX reviews it and answers by e-mail.

options.title: Add the options to medusa-config.ts
options.body: clientId, clientSecret, redirectUri and encryptionKey (at least 32 random characters), from environment variables. Then restart Medusa.

defaults.title: Set the defaults
defaults.body: Contact person and city in Settings, so forms come pre-filled.

images.title: Check that photos are public
images.body: OLX downloads photos by address, so they must be on a public https URL. Local file storage on localhost will not work.

first.title: Publish the first advert
first.body: Open a product, tab OLX, and click Publish.

guide.title: How it works
guide.subtitle: OLX in your store, in plain words.

what.title: What it does
what.text: Each variant can have one OLX advert. You publish and edit it from the product page; the store keeps track of its status.

publish.title: Publishing
publish.text: Nothing goes to OLX by itself. The form starts from the product and your defaults, you check it and click Publish. OLX moderates the advert, usually within seconds.

sold.title: When it sells
sold.text:
Sold in the store: the advert comes down by itself, at once and checked again every 5 minutes.
Sold on OLX: click "Sold on OLX". Free stock goes to zero and the advert comes down.
Stock coming back never republishes an advert: you decide with "Bring back".

paid.title: Costs
paid.text: Adverts in some categories are paid on OLX. The plugin never buys packets or promotions. An advert over your limit shows "Over the limit" until you handle it on OLX.

limits.title: What it does not do
limits.text: No OLX orders or Przesyłka OLX, no messages, no promotions. OLX cannot tell the plugin about a sale agreed in chat, so that one needs the "Sold on OLX" button.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.text: With demo: true everything works on sample data, without an OLX account. Nothing is sent and stock does not change.
